text: Scheidt's habit is a key made of parts joined by a rule. Two words added letter by letter was tried before (0115). Here the rule changes: the words are numbered by an alphabet mixed from a third word, or their numbers are multiplied.

For every first word from the puzzle, at every start, the 24 known letters dictate the second word's letters; any consistent second word is looked up in the dictionary in every rotation. Exact; ten scrambled copies; two planted texts.
Not one pair of first word and length survives on K4 or on any copy; both planted texts come back word for word. F3.1 closed.
